ye17f0b745e0.add: - **Budget in parts:** **Rule 213** of the Lok Sabha Rules of Procedure lets the Budget be presented in **two or more parts**, each dealt with as if it were the Budget (Rule 204 fixes the day of presentation; no discussion that day).

yae1d8e4cd2a.add: - **Became a parliamentary committee:** after the Constitution, the PAC became a committee of Parliament under the Speaker in **1950** (set up 1921).

y9da5fd6574b.add: - **Chairs 2024-25 (18th LS):** PAC – **K.C. Venugopal**; Estimates – **Sanjay Jaiswal**; COPU – **Baijayant Panda** (so "Estimates – Baijayant Panda" is wrong).

yd7f35adf56b.add: - **Ethics Committees:** idea mooted in the Rajya Sabha in **1992**; **RS Ethics Committee constituted 4 March 1997** (functioning from May 1997); **Lok Sabha** Ethics Committee first set up as an **ad hoc** committee on **16 May 2000**, made a **permanent** part of the LS Rules in **2015**.

yf3bb817f6c1.add: - **2G spectrum JPC (2011):** **30 members = 20 LS + 10 RS**, chaired by **P.C. Chacko** (the 15 + 7 split is the PAC / COPU).

y89cf5d9f0e8.add: - **Consultative Committees:** constituted by the **Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs** (for each ministry, and informal ones for Railway Zones); MPs of both Houses, chaired by the Minister – they are **not** parliamentary committees in the strict sense.

n40eb01540cf.add: - **"Continuous economy committee":** the **Estimates Committee** (it suggests economies in expenditure year after year).

nee7cf8fcba1.add: - **Speaker as ex-officio chairperson:** Business Advisory Committee, **Rules Committee** and General Purposes Committee (not PAC, Estimates or COPU, whose chairs he appoints).

nindian-polity-39-25.add: - **2G spectrum JPC (2011):** **30 members = 20 LS + 10 RS**, chaired by **P.C. Chacko** (the 15 + 7 split is the PAC / COPU).

n734fac6257a.add: - **DRSC chairpersons:** appointed by the **Speaker** for the 16 Lok Sabha DRSCs and by the **Chairman, Rajya Sabha** for the 8 RS DRSCs.

nindian-polity-35-28.add: - **Ministers barred:** Ministers cannot be members of the Committee on Petitions, the Committee on Subordinate Legislation or the Welfare of SCs and STs Committee (nor of the financial committees).

nindian-polity-35-43.add: - **Consultative Committees:** constituted by the **Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs** (for each ministry, and informal ones for Railway Zones); MPs of both Houses, chaired by the Minister – they are **not** parliamentary committees in the strict sense.

n888fc066916.add: - **Committee on Papers Laid on the Table:** checks that papers laid by Ministers (other than statutory orders, which go to Subordinate Legislation) comply with the Constitution, the Act or rule concerned.

g21ffc46e61f9.add: - **Committee on Empowerment of Women:** set up for both Houses on **29 April 1997**; **30 = 20 LS + 10 RS**.
